articles.summary: Prepare for the Rift-Touched Ancient Wyrm, the Mimic King and the teleporting Corrupted Soulless.
articles.keywords: boss ancient wyrm rift mimic king corrupted soulless phases fire energy burst telegraph arena group health resistance loot

sections.title: Available boss definitions
paragraphs: Three prominent custom encounters are configured: the Rift-Touched Ancient Wyrm, the Mimic King and the Corrupted Soulless. Their definitions and combat routines are loaded; no automatic public location or recurring appearance schedule is established here.

sections.title: Rift Wyrm and Mimic King phases
paragraphs: The Rift-Touched Ancient Wyrm has 12,000 health and the Mimic King 10,000. Both enter their second phase at 70% health and their third at 35%, checked as they take hits.

Phase two reduces scripted incoming hit damage by 10% and raises outgoing melee hit damage by 10%. Phase three uses 20% for each. These are the boss phase modifiers; other combat mitigation and resistance still apply.

The Wyrm stores resistance properties of physical 60, fire 80, cold 70, poison 70 and energy 65. The Mimic King stores physical 65, fire 55, cold 55, poison 70 and energy 65. Percentage-based elemental resistance reduction is disabled in the current configuration, so these values describe stored creature properties rather than current elemental weaknesses or damage reduction.

sections.title: Avoid the telegraphed burst
paragraphs: The first warning is scheduled 27 seconds after the ability scheduler starts. A burst follows 3 seconds later, with later warnings scheduled 30 seconds apart.
Move beyond 8 tiles of the boss before the burst lands. The area check targets living players on the same facet within that radius. The Wyrm’s burst is fire damage; the Mimic King’s is energy damage.

Configured base burst damage is 30 in phase one, 40 in phase two and 55 in phase three. These are script damage amounts before applicable native damage processing. Current combat does not apply the stored elemental-resistance percentages as percentage reductions.

sections.title: Corrupted Soulless
paragraphs: The Corrupted Soulless has 1,800–2,200 configured health and strong melee and spell skills. Its stored resistance properties generally range around 55–70, with percentage-based elemental reduction disabled in current combat. It starts its ability loop after 5 seconds, then repeats every 8–12 seconds.

Each loop has a 40% blink choice; otherwise it emits an area pulse dealing a configured 28–42 damage within 7 tiles. The pulse affects living characters around it, including nearby NPCs, rather than only player characters.

Blink positions are selected around its arena anchor within a configured 12-tile coordinate radius and checked for line of sight. Its melee hit trigger also has a 10% blink chance. Movement and spacing matter throughout the fight.

sections.title: Boss rewards
paragraphs: Read the individual boss entry for its actual reward declarations and central-gold eligibility. The Wyrm’s 20,000-gold resource line and the Guild Mark resource lines on these phased bosses are carving-resource configuration, not evidence of guaranteed currency or Marks in the ordinary death-loot list.

A boss name, high difficulty rating or large health pool does not itself establish a unique rare-item table. The catalogue distinguishes explicit death rewards, carried equipment and carving resources.

articles.title: Creature attacks & encounter hazards
articles.summary: Recognize dismounts, bleeding, summoning, drain attacks and reactive elemental auras.
articles.keywords: monster ability special move bleed mortal wound dismount poison acid aura cold fire energy summoning drain pixie spider paroxysmus dread horn semidar

sections.title: Reactive auras and drain attacks
paragraphs: Some special moves happen when the monster is hit. Standing beside an aura creature can therefore expose you or your pet to repeated area damage while the group attacks it.

Ice and Snow Elementals have configured reactive cold auras dealing 10–20 cold damage to players and pets within 3 tiles. Enabled extended behavior gives similar frost or fire auras to specific creatures; fire consumes mana.

Semidar can drain 10–20 physical damage from nearby players and pets and heal itself. Shimmering Effusion has a reactive energy area attack and can create additional creatures. Ethereal Warrior extended behavior restores health and drains stamina and mana in proportion to its hit damage.

sections.title: Dismounting and pet pressure
paragraphs: Flesh Renderers, Savage Riders and Malefic have mounted-target attacks that can dismount a victim and add 15–25 physical damage, subject to their mana checks. Do not rely on remaining mounted throughout those fights.

Dread Horn has a special additional 50–100 physical-damage hit that always qualifies against a controlled-pet victim, or can trigger against other victims through its random check. Its definition also contains reactive movement behavior.
Chief Paroxysmus can spend mana on additional physical damage or Curse. Its Curse guard checks for existing Curse or Mass Curse spell effects before applying the extra debuff.

sections.title: Bleeding and mortal wounds
paragraphs: Impaler, Darknight Creeper, Malefic and Silk Spider definitions include bleeding attacks. The shared bleeding effect delivers five diminishing damage ticks two seconds apart before ending.

Impaler and Virulent Spider definitions can apply the shared mortal-wound timer. Its implemented behavior interrupts actions repeatedly for a short period. The timer’s label alone should not be read as proof that every healing spell is blocked; its source does not provide a universal healing-block check.
Timed paralysis and wounds can affect your ability to keep moving or treat damage. Their chance, mana requirement and repetition checks differ by creature.

sections.title: Summons and reinforcements
paragraphs: Bone Daemon can create an undead reinforcement when struck. Spider Lord can create Dread Spiders. Forest Lord and Forest Queen can create four pixies from a reactive trigger.

Some enabled extended behaviors also create temporary Dread Spiders or Fire Ant Workers. These encounter reinforcements should not automatically be treated as permanent pets or full-value reward targets.
A Savage Rider creates a Savage Ridgeback when it dies. Plague Beast’s enabled corpse-eating behavior adds 200 current and maximum health when it consumes a corpse not already used for that effect.

sections.title: Poison and acid
paragraphs: Read explicit ability notes alongside the Poisoning skill. A configured Poisoning value alone does not establish a universal on-hit poison chance.

The shared reactive poison and solen-spit behaviors operate against attackers more than 2 tiles away and consume mana. Solen acid spit also creates a short-lived ground pool; the pool’s player step effect deals a configured 10–15 damage.

Individual creatures can use separate poisoning conditions. Crystal Slime can duplicate itself when struck and has its own rare poisoning hit. The Paroxysmus dragon-pet definition has a mana-gated poison attack against a victim not already poisoned.

sections.title: Build an encounter plan
paragraphs: Plan around the monster’s active attacks, area radius, movement and special moves before choosing your position and companion. Current combat does not activate percentage reduction from the stored elemental-resistance properties. Native fire immunity is a separate property. A large group can trigger more reactive effects as it deals more hits.

The bestiary records configured behavior rather than a guaranteed ability rotation. Mana, current targets, random rolls and combat state control which moves actually occur. For the phased custom bosses, use the separate boss guide to learn their explicit warning and burst timing.

sections.title: Spawn groups describe encounter mixes

Each pool describes possible creature choices. A weight is relative to the other choices in that same pool: a weight of 6 is selected twice as often as a weight of 3 when the pool is used.

sections.title: Wildlife and habitats
paragraphs: Animal groups include broad wildlife, birds, forest animals and water creatures. Water creatures can include hostile enemies such as elementals, krakens and sea serpents alongside ordinary aquatic animals.

Habitat groups represent environments rather than difficulty tiers. Check individual enemy ratings and behavior instead of assuming a forest, swamp or waterside group contains only beginner creatures.

sections.title: Town and dungeon populations
paragraphs: City and human groups include civilian professions and service NPCs as well as hostile human populations in their appropriate groups. Their civil or combat role changes which reward rules apply.

Dungeon and monster groups collect families such as undead, giants, dragons and other supernatural creatures. Named or expansion-origin definitions may be loaded for compatibility or placement even when no current encounter location is established.
This guide does not turn a loaded group definition into a promised world spawn. Use in-game exploration and current server announcements for actual encounter availability.

sections.title: World population pools

sections.title: Start with two skills
paragraphs: Necromancy controls casting checks and has a base cap of 100.0. Spirit Speak supplies power for its damage and several curse durations. Both skills count toward the unchanged 1,200.0 total skill cap. You do not need to choose Warlock to use the school; Warlock adds its own rank-based talents.

For ordinary book casting, carry the spell in your Necromancy book, meet its listed Necromancy requirement and have enough mana and reagents. Normal targeting, visibility, resistance and region checks still apply. The reference below lists configured book costs and base cast times before other adjustments.

Mage shops sell Bat Wings, Grave Dust, Vial of Blood (daemon blood), Nox Crystals and Pig Iron. Inscription’s Necromancy category makes all 17 scrolls, and its Spellbooks category makes a Necromancy book with 50.0 Inscription, pen and ink, and ten blank scrolls.
The crafted Exorcism scroll’s casting and book-learning behavior still needs verification. The spell reference below describes Exorcism’s book entry.

sections.title: How Spirit Speak changes damage
paragraphs: Poison Strike and Wither use Spirit Speak, rather than Necromancy or Evaluating Intelligence, for their base damage. These two curves limit their Spirit Speak input to 0.0–100.0. Final damage can change with target resistance, armor, class effects and other combat adjustments.

Poison Strike affects the primary target and visible creatures within two tiles of it. Splash damage is weaker than the primary hit. Wither affects visible targets within four tiles of the caster and gains 25% base damage against targets above 1,000 karma.

Pain Spike deals ten timed ticks in this realm and does not refund those lost hit points when it ends. Pain Spike and Strangle retain Spirit Speak power scaling. Blood Oath, Corpse Skin, Curse Weapon and Mind Rot use Spirit Speak duration scaling, with resistance where applicable; Blood Oath, Corpse Skin and Mind Rot have a minimum one-second duration.

paragraphs: Curse of Agony, Pact Familiar and Life for Power strengthen eligible Pain Spike, Poison Strike, Strangle and Wither effects. Soul Leech restores health from their actual positive damage, including timed pulses. Dread Presence protects you from attackers carrying your own active curses.

The talent bonuses depend on spent ranks, with no extra school skill gate or school multiplier. Magery does not receive these damage bonuses, trigger Soul Leech or consume Life for Power. The Warlock guide gives the full formulas and ownership rules.

articles.title: Chivalry: tithing and all ten spells
articles.summary: Shrine donations, karma, healing, consecrated weapons, travel and every spell’s mana and tithing cost.

sections.title: Prepare your skill, book and tithing
paragraphs: Chivalry has a base skill cap of 100.0 within the unchanged 1,200.0 total cap. Its spells use Chivalry, mana and tithing points. Positive karma improves selected healing, damage and duration values. You do not need to choose Paladin to cast them; Paladin adds its own rank-based talents.

The Book of Chivalry contains the school’s ten spells and can be made with 50.0 Inscription, pen and ink, and ten blank scrolls. Ordinary Chivalry book casts use no reagents. Meet the listed casting skill requirement and keep enough mana and tithing for the spell.

At a shrine, open the tithing option from its context menu. Donate 100, 1,000 or 10,000 gold from your backpack: each gold gives one tithing point. You can hold at most 100,000 points. Remain alive, in sight and within two tiles of the shrine while confirming. Choose a smaller donation if the full amount would exceed your cap.

sections.title: All ten Chivalry spells
paragraphs: These are configured ordinary book costs and base cast times before other adjustments. Each spell also retains its normal targeting and region checks.

rows: Cure poison at a health cost to the cured target.
Heal a living target; poison or bleeding prevents the heal.
Consecrate the held weapon to help overcome armor.
Dispel hostile summons or drain stamina and frighten ordinary hostile creatures within five tiles.
Restore stamina and improve attack speed/offense at a defense cost.
Deal 50% more weapon damage to the chosen creature kind; other kinds deal double damage to you.
Damage eligible hostile creatures within five tiles.
Cure, stop bleeding and heal nearby living players/your pets, or attempt resurrection; leave your health, stamina and mana at one.
Remove supported stat curses and Necromancy curses from a living target.
Travel using an accessible marked rune in your backpack, with a safe Felucca destination.

sections.title: Choose the right heal
paragraphs: Close Wounds needs a living visible target within 12 tiles on the same facet. It cannot heal through poison or bleeding. Cleanse by Fire cures poison first, but its health cost is paid by the cured target; that cost cannot reduce the target below one health.

Close Wounds’ base heal is 10 + floor(Chivalry / 5) + floor(positive karma / 1,000), using Chivalry in displayed skill points. An exact Chivalry input of 100.0 gives 30 health at karma 0 or 40 at karma 10,000, before talent bonuses. Noble Sacrifice starts with ten more healing points. These formulas bound Chivalry input at 120.0 and positive karma at 10,000; the base training cap remains 100.0. Health is capped at the recipient’s maximum.

Noble Sacrifice affects visible nearby players and your controlled pets within five tiles. Living recipients are cured of poison and bleeding and healed; dead recipients receive a resurrection attempt. After casting, your remaining health, stamina and mana become one. Plan for the recovery before using it.

Paladin Aura of Devotion improves Close Wounds and Noble Sacrifice and reduces Cleanse by Fire’s health cost. It does not improve Magery Heal or Greater Heal. Lay on Hands is a separate talent with its own cure, bleeding removal and healing formula.

sections.title: Use holy combat effects carefully
paragraphs: Consecrate Weapon applies to the weapon actually held when the effect begins. Its armor benefit and the Paladin Smite addition require that same weapon for the hit.

Divine Fury restores stamina and hastens attacks while improving offense and reducing defense. Enemy of One chooses the first eligible hostile creature kind you hit: your weapon damage against that kind is multiplied by 1.5, while damage you receive from other creature kinds is doubled for the effect’s duration.

Holy Light and Dispel Evil affect eligible hostile creatures within five tiles and in sight, excluding players, owned pets and invulnerable creatures. Paladin’s Turn talent adds its Holy Light damage bonus specifically against undead and demons.

sections.title: Travel with Sacred Journey
paragraphs: Use an accessible marked rune carried in your backpack. Its destination must be a safe, walkable Felucca location, and the rune must still have a charge. Anti-magic restrictions still apply.
Sacred Journey refuses travel in war mode, while criminal or overloaded. A successful journey spends one rune charge. Other facets are not supported.

articles.title: Crafting workshops & batch crafting
articles.summary: Choose recipes and materials, check your chances, and make batches of 1–200 items across all nine crafting skills.
articles.keywords: crafting workshop batch materials change recent recipes make last maker mark success failure superior quality

sections.title: Open a workshop
paragraphs: Start with your normal profession tools. Smithing begins from ingots with a hammer equipped; tailoring begins with a sewing kit on cloth or hides. Wood carving starts from a blade used on wood, and ammunition from shafts. Use a mapmaker’s pen for Cartography. Inscription begins from a blank scroll. Magery scrolls also need the spell in your book, mana and casting requirements; school scrolls use their listed crafting skills. Cooking needs a nearby heat source.

Choose a category, then a recipe. Its detail page shows your current and required skills, tools and stations, ingredients per attempt, backpack stock, and success and failure chances. Longer recipes have another ingredient page. Supplies in your bank do not fund a crafting job.

sections.title: Choose the material
paragraphs: Use Change when a recipe supports alternate ingots, woods or leather. The selected output has its own ingredient quantities and skill requirements. Recipes with fixed ingredients have no material switch.

A recipe family groups the same kind of item across supported materials. The current workshop has 415 families and 1,131 output variants, including the Necromancy and Chivalry additions to Inscription. The profession guides list every output with its own requirements.

sections.title: Craft a batch
paragraphs: Enter 1–200 items, or use the 1, 10, 50 or 200 buttons. This is the number of successful items you want, rather than a number of attempts. Each item takes its ordinary crafting time and uses the normal skill, gain and quality rolls.

The minimum material total covers successful items only. Failed attempts may consume extra supplies. You can start a partially supplied batch, which stops when its requirements are no longer met. A batch also stops after ten attempts per requested item.

The progress page shows items made, failures and total attempts. Stop crafting or Close cancels further attempts; completed items stay in your backpack. Logout, death, combat, lost tools or materials, or insufficient pack room stop a batch. Smithing and cooking also stop when you leave their required stations. Crafting does not resume automatically after login.

sections.title: Recent recipes, Make last & Mark
paragraphs: Recent recipes remembers the last ten recipes for each skill. Make last repeats the last recipe and material with your selected quantity.

Mark controls maker attribution on superior work made at Grandmaster skill. The superior-quality chance is shown separately, conditional on successfully making the item. It does not replace the ordinary crafting roll.

sections.title: Learned custom recipes
paragraphs: Ordinary recipes do not require a recipe scroll. The eight Wayfarer’s Verse Bard pieces are separate discoveries under Tailoring → Custom Recipes. Each is unlocked permanently for the character who learns its scroll.

An unlearned entry is grey and marked Locked. You may browse its requirements, but its Craft control becomes available only after learning. The Custom recipe discoveries guide lists the eight costs, drop sources and special materials.

articles.title: Custom recipe discoveries
articles.summary: Learn the eight Wayfarer’s Verse Bard Tailoring recipes, find scrolls, and plan their exact Harmonic Cloth costs.
articles.keywords: custom recipes scroll learn locked Wayfarer Verse Bard Harmonic Cloth monster difficulty treasure map chest fishing GM drop 1 in 500

sections.title: Learn a recipe permanently
paragraphs: Double-click a recipe scroll in your backpack to learn its item permanently on that character. One scroll is consumed. A duplicate stays in your backpack so you can trade or give it away.

Learning does not bypass the required skills, tools, materials or stations. Regular crafting remains available without recipe scrolls. Under Tailoring → Custom Recipes, an unlearned entry is grey and marked Locked; selecting it still shows its requirements. Learned entries display normally and enable Craft.

sections.title: Wayfarer’s Verse Bard pieces
paragraphs: Each piece needs its own learned recipe, a sewing kit, Harmonic Cloth and thread. All eight use Tailoring. A full set needs at least 140 Harmonic Cloth and 19 thread before any failure waste.

Ordinary cloth cannot replace Harmonic Cloth, even if the color matches. These cloth pieces retain the actual ingredient’s color. The workshop supports 1–200 successful items, using the ordinary success, failure and superior-quality rules.

sections.title: Where recipe scrolls come from
paragraphs: Each qualifying event rolls once and can award at most one scroll. All eight initial recipes are available from all three source types with equal selection weight. These are independent rolls, so the stated rate does not guarantee a drop after a set number of kills, chests or catches.

tables.caption: Current recipe scroll chances
rows: Successful fish catch at real/base Fishing 100.0 or higher

items: Monsters at difficulty 80 or below do not qualify. Pets, summons, invulnerable creatures, civilians, guards and passive wildlife are excluded.
Treasure-map chests roll when filled; reopening a chest does not give another chance.
Fishing requires a confirmed successful catch with real/base Grandmaster Fishing. Skill bonuses cannot qualify a character below 100.0. Failed, empty or cancelled catches do not award a scroll.

sections.title: Buy special materials with tickets
paragraphs: The Ticket Exchange Stone sells ten special cloths and ten special ingots for 100–150 tradeable tickets per unit. These are distinct materials that stack with matching units. The ticket guide lists every material price.

Harmonic Cloth costs 120 tickets per unit and is the exact cloth used by the eight Bard recipes. Their full set’s minimum cloth purchase therefore costs 16,800 tickets, plus thread and any supplies lost to failed attempts.

The remaining special materials are available for future recipes. They do not automatically replace ordinary materials or grant a crafting property. No special-material monster drops or gathering nodes are added by this system.

articles.title: Ticket Exchange Stone
articles.summary: Recycle unwanted backpack items for tradeable tickets, then buy special crafting materials or reusable ethereal mounts.
articles.keywords: ticket exchange stone recycling bag contents materials cloth ingots ethereal mount statue tradeable currency reward

sections.title: How exchange tickets work
paragraphs: The Ticket Exchange Stone recycles unwanted backpack items into physical, tradeable tickets. Double-click the stone while standing beside it, then choose Recycling → Select an item or bag.

The preview shows the value before anything is consumed. Confirm recycling permanently destroys the eligible units and puts their tickets in your backpack. Check the selection and payout before confirming. Tickets use an emerald graphic but remain separate currency; ordinary emerald gems retain their normal item value.

Eligible items return 1–10 tickets per unit based on their item definition. For example, 200 ordinary cloth at one ticket per unit returns 200 tickets. Names, item tags and vendor gold prices do not determine the payout. Gold, exchange tickets and bags or containers have no ticket value.

sections.title: Recycle one item or part of a pile
paragraphs: Target an accessible item in your own backpack. For a pile, choose the number of units and update the quote, then review the total and confirm. Equipped items, bank items, other players’ items and world fixtures are excluded. No-trade, quest and ticket-protected items are retained.

A quote expires after two minutes. Changing or moving the item, moving away from the stone, dying or closing the menu prevents that confirmation. Select the item again for a fresh quote. The exchange checks backpack capacity before consuming anything.

sections.title: Recycle the contents of a bag
paragraphs: Target an ordinary bag in your backpack to preview all eligible contents, including accessible nested bags. Confirming recycles eligible piles in full. The selected bag and every nested bag remain; gold, tickets, protected items and contents inside locked or protected bags remain too.

The preview totals eligible units and stacks, retained bags and other stacks, and the ticket payout. Bag exchanges have no quantity entry. Empty bags and bags with no eligible contents cannot produce tickets. Moving the bag or changing its contents invalidates the preview.

A selection can contain up to 512 objects, including the selected bag, nested containers and retained contents, across at most 32 nested levels. Exchanges above 10,000,000 tickets must be split into smaller selections. If the menu reports a partial exchange, only consumed eligible units are paid.

sections.title: Spend tickets on rewards
paragraphs: Browse a reward category, select an item and review its price and purchase limit. Buy selected reward completes the purchase. Special materials allow 1–200 units per purchase; ethereal statues are bought individually.

Payments can use multiple ticket piles and accessible nested bags. Tickets in your bank, locked containers or protected containers do not fund purchases. Leave enough free backpack room for the reward.

sections.title: Ethereal statues
paragraphs: Each statue costs 250,000 tickets and supplies a reusable ethereal mount. Keep it in your backpack and double-click it to summon and ride. Dismount or double-click the same statue to return the mount.

The same physical statue is retained; riding does not create a second tradeable pet. The statue is held in place while mounted and can be traded again after returning the mount. Statues are blessed and survive ordinary death. Death and logout return the temporary mount to its statue.
